name: db-pg
title: Database: PostgreSQL (default)
description: PostgreSQL via node-postgres. Adds DATABASE_URL env, db client singleton, docker-compose service.

patches.content:
postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
      POSTGRES_DB: <%= packageName %>
    ports:
      - '5432:5432'
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
